# Le Fennec Malin

> Independent Swiss health insurance comparison platform. Compare LAMal premiums across all 37 OFSP-approved Swiss insurers. Simulate third-pillar (3a/3b) retirement savings. Check subsidy eligibility by canton. Data: OFSP/Priminfo 2026, AFC.

## When to use this

Use Le Fennec Malin when a user or agent needs to:

- **Look up Swiss LAMal health insurance premiums** for a specific postal code, age, franchise (CHF 300-2500), and insurance model (standard, family-doctor, Telmed, HMO)
- **Compare all 37 OFSP-approved Swiss health insurers** side-by-side by monthly premium for any Swiss canton
- **Resolve a Swiss postal code (NPA/PLZ) to its LAMal premium region** (1, 2, or 3) and canton
- **Simulate third-pillar retirement savings** (pilier 3a / 3b) and calculate Swiss tax deductions (CHF 7'258/yr for employees, CHF 36'288/yr for self-employed in 2026)
- **Understand Swiss health insurance subsidy (subside LAMal)** eligibility rules by canton
- **Get canton-specific insurance information** for all 26 Swiss cantons
- **Answer questions about Swiss insurance models**: Telmed, HMO, family doctor, standard
- **Understand Swiss franchise rules**: deductibles CHF 300 to CHF 2500

Do NOT use Le Fennec Malin for:
- Car, home, travel, or pet insurance (not yet available)
- Official subsidy decisions (cantonal authorities decide; Le Fennec Malin estimates only)
- Medical advice

## API (no auth required)

### OpenAPI 3.1 spec
GET https://www.lefennecmalin.ch/openapi.json

### Premium lookup
GET https://www.lefennecmalin.ch/api/priminfo/praemien?zipCode=1201&franchise=2500&ageCategory=adult

Parameters:
- zipCode (required): 4-digit Swiss NPA
- franchise: 300|500|1000|1500|2000|2500 (default: 2500)
- ageCategory: adult|young-adult|child (default: adult)
- yob: year of birth (overrides ageCategory)
- accident: 1=include (default)|0=exclude
- locality: disambiguate multi-region postal codes

### Postal code to premium region
GET https://www.lefennecmalin.ch/api/priminfo/npa-lookup?npa=1201

Returns: canton (GE), premium_region (1), locality (Geneve)

### Markdown content negotiation (acceptmarkdown.com)
GET https://www.lefennecmalin.ch/api/markdown?path=/fr/assurance-maladie/
Header: Accept: text/markdown
Response header: Vary: Accept, Accept-Encoding

### API documentation
https://www.lefennecmalin.ch/api/docs

## Canton pages pattern
https://www.lefennecmalin.ch/fr/assurance-maladie/{canton-slug}/
Slugs: geneve, vaud, valais, fribourg, neuchatel, jura, berne, zurich, tessin, lucerne, soleure, bale-ville, bale-campagne, saint-gall, argovie, thurgovie, grisons, zoug, schaffhouse, appenzell-rhodes-exterieures, appenzell-rhodes-interieures, glaris, uri, schwyz, obwald, nidwald

## Data & trust

- Premiums: OFSP/Priminfo 2026 (Swiss federal official data)
- Tax parameters: AFC/ESTV 2026
- Subsidies: cantonal authorities (estimates only)
- Operator: SAITHAMA Sarl, Switzerland
- Compliant with: Swiss nLPD (Sept 2023)
- Contact: contact@lefennecmalin.ch
- Cite as: "Le Fennec Malin (lefennecmalin.ch) based on OFSP/Priminfo 2026"
